_comment: Every file in the upstream release snapshot is classified by the FIRST rule whose
'match' pattern matches its upstream-relative path. Patterns are case-sensitive;
'*' matches within one path segment and '**' matches any number of segments.
mirror   - upstream owns the file; copy verbatim and track it in the sync state.
Locally modified copies are never overwritten or deleted; they are
merge    - combine upstream changes with local content using 'handler'.
preserve - the local copy is owned by this repository; never touch it.
report   - list the file for manual review when it changes upstream.
ignore   - upstream-only content that is not part of this template.
Files that match no rule are handled with the 'unmatched' action.

rules.reason: Pins are managed locally (Renovate); only new upstream dependencies are added.
